story_description: Build the settings window foundation, navigation, categories, and search.
task_description: The current settings UI is a basic TabView. A modern macOS app needs a NavigationSplitView with sidebar navigation, search, and glass styling.
atom_description: The current settings UI is a basic TabView. A modern macOS app needs a NavigationSplitView with sidebar navigation, search, and glass styling.
problem_statement: The current settings UI is a basic TabView. A modern macOS app needs a NavigationSplitView with sidebar navigation, search, and glass styling.
scope_in: Settings window container with NavigationSplitView; category sidebar; search bar; detail panel routing
Implement SettingsWindow.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Individual category view implementations; actual settings logic
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Category detail views exist or will be stubbed
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must follow macOS Settings window conventions
Must use glass styling via DSGlass
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
Default window size 1200 x 800 and resizable
Transparent titlebar with traffic lights visible
Background clear, isOpaque false, shadow enabled
functional_requirements: Display sidebar with all 12 SettingsCategory options
Route category selection to appropriate detail view
Include search bar that filters categories and settings
Apply glass styling to both sidebar and detail panels
Use NavigationSplitView for sidebar, detail, and search.
Sidebar lists all SettingsCategory cases with icons and titles.
Detail pane routes to the selected category view.
implementation_steps: Add search bar with filtering logic
ui_states: Search no results: "No matching settings" message
ui_interactions: Click category in sidebar → detail panel updates
Type in search bar → sidebar filters
edge_cases: Search returns no results - show empty state message
Window opened while already open - bring existing to front
Selected category filtered out by search - keep selection, show filtered sidebar
failure_modes: Category detail view crashes - show error view, don't crash app
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Revert to previous TabView-based settings; remove SettingsWindow.swift

unit: Unit test core logic for SettingsWindow.swift with representative inputs.
Verify serialization or formatting logic where applicable.
integration: Integration test SettingsWindow.swift with dependent stores or managers.
ui: Verify previews render; manual test navigation
Verify SwiftUI previews render without crash.
security: Ensure no sensitive data is logged.
Verify file permissions for any on-disk artifacts.

acceptance_tests: Click "Security" in sidebar → Security settings shown
Open the Settings UI and verify the expected controls and behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Functional requirements are implemented as specified.
completed_when: All definition of done criteria are met and verification steps pass.
completed_evidence: Passing tests, verification steps completed, and artifact outputs present.
open_questions: No open questions; specification is complete for this atom.
verification_steps: Click "Security" in sidebar → Security settings shown
Open the Settings UI and verify the expected controls and behavior.

risks: NavigationSplitView behavior may differ from expectations
risk_register.fallback_plan: Revert to TabView if NavigationSplitView issues

persistence: Persistence uses AppStorage for settings values where applicable, or file storage for theme and hooks data.
